provenance: FIXTURE EVIDENCE — scripted engineering captures of the published v1.22.0 CLI and Viewer. Not human-observation evidence.
simulatedHarnessNote: Harness detection in v1.22.0 is configuration-path based (src/bootstrap/connect.ts detectInstalledHarnesses). Every harness presence this run is a simulated marker directory in an isolated HOME/XDG; no real codex or opencode process was launched and no real harness config was touched.

assertions.ambientEndpointsRemoved: CAMPFIRE_URL and CAMPFIRE_TOKEN removed from every child environment
assertions.isolatedDirs: HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, CAMPFIRE_CONFIG_DIR, CAMPFIRE_DATA_DIR, TMPDIR per scenario
assertions.userIdentity: USER=LOGNAME=owner for a deterministic name-prompt default
assertions.noRealBrowser: CAMPFIRE_NO_BROWSER=1, --no-open, or a PATH `open` shim that only logs the URL
assertions.noLastingHarness: no harness process is started; detection is filesystem-only

methodNotes.pty: python3 pty, 24x100, child session leader with controlling pty; stderr shares the terminal stream; an interactive step is only used for C11 (wait for the `[campfire] HTTP …` listener line, then a real SIGINT (\u0003) after a 300 ms delay so the signal cannot race the shutdown-handler registration); frames are the raw stream text (CRLF line endings; expectation matching normalizes \r\n to \n)
methodNotes.ptyTermios: check `termiosRestored` is recorded false in every PTY case, including clean exit-0 runs: on macOS, tcgetattr on the pty slave fails with ENOTTY once the session leader has exited, so the post-exit snapshot is unreadable. This is a driver limitation, not a dirty-terminal observation.
methodNotes.piped: spawnSync with piped stdin/stdout/stderr; no terminal anywhere
methodNotes.daemon: detached child; SIGINT to its process group; stderr/stdout collected
methodNotes.statusOutputMode: `campfire status` has outputModes auto/human/json (src/cli/catalog.ts spec + src/cli/output.ts resolveOutputMode): stdout TTY renders human, a pipe renders JSON unless --output human is passed. Bare `campfire` is outside that rule and stays human unless explicit JSON (src/cli/index.ts commandOutput).

maskingRules: see BASELINE_PIN.md — cft-shaped credential tokens -> [redacted]; cfe-shaped invitation secrets -> [one-time-credential: redacted]; absolute /Users, /private, /var/folders, /tmp paths -> [path]; loopback ports -> [port]; ISO timestamps -> [timestamp]; UUIDs -> [uuid]; object ids (<prefix>_<16 hex>) -> <prefix>_[id]
